messages:
jess_support: Customer (john_customer) reports offer code EARLYACCESS-11 rejected as expired when redeeming from mobile after travel. Dashboard shows code valid until 2026-03-14 end-of-day, but API returns 410/"code_expired". Can someone triage?

john_customer: I got the offer email while in PST (2026-03-13 16:10 PST). I tried to redeem at 2026-03-14 09:15 JST (still within the advertised period) and got "invalid/expired". Screenshot attached to the support ticket.

ella_agent: Thanks — can you DM the request headers and the exact API response body? Also which app version (iOS/Android/web)?

jess_support: iOS 5.2.1. Customer pasted API response: `{"error":"code_expired","expires_at":"2026-03-14T00:00:00Z"}` — odd because dashboard expiry is `2026-03-14T23:59:59Z` (customer-facing).

sam_billing: I'm pulling billing/promo logs for code EARLYACCESS-11. Found claim attempts: user_id=u_901, ts=1764054305, resp=410, expiry_epoch=1700000000 and an older entry with expiry_epoch=1678742400. Looks like mixed expiries.

dev_matt: Quick sanity check on the epochs: 1700000000 ~ 2023-11-14T... (seems off) and 1678742400 maps to 2023-03-13. Those are clearly wrong for a 2026 offer. Dump from promo-service log attached: ``[2026-03-14T00:00:05Z] promo-service calc_expiry(user=u_901) -> expiry_ts=1719993600; using cached policy expiry=1678742400 for code EARLYACCESS-11``. My hunch: configstore cache still holding old policy from a prior migration.

jess_support: Repro steps for eng: 1) create test org 2) add code EARLYACCESS-11 via admin UI with gui-expiry 2026-03-14 23:59:59 3) run: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/claim -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"code":"EARLYACCESS-11","user":"u_test"}'``` 4) observe 410 with body `{"error":"code_expired","expiry_epoch":1678742400}`

dev_matt: Can infra flush configstore cache for promo-service? Also adding a short-term guard: if computed expiry > cached expiry by >30d, prefer computed and emit metric.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: cache-flush request received for promo-service configstore by dev_matt at 2026-03-14T00:12:30Z — flush complete (ok).

sam_billing: Re-tested the claim after flush using the repro curl above — response is 200 and credits applied to u_test. Verified with billing transaction id tx_7732.

dev_matt: Filed follow-up task (ENG-1459) to add TTL and mismatched-expiry alert. Root cause: stale configstore entry after promo migration; not a timezone conversion bug.

jess_support: Great — I'll update the customer that this was a stale cache / migration artifact and credits have been applied. :thumbsup:
